claim: Metformin reduces the expression of genes involved in pro-inflammatory Th1/Th17 cell differentiation in diabetic patients.
rationale: PMID: 37773574 states metformin treatment was associated with reduced expression of genes involved in Th1/Th17 cell differentiation.
